The package installs only static assets (binary, license, documentation, config, locale files, desktop entry, icon) into standard system directories. Dependencies and optional dependencies are reasonable and documented. No scripts are executed during install, and no system state is altered beyond file installation. The package conforms to standard AUR packaging practices and shows no signs of malicious behavior.

No `git pull`, `eval`, or other dynamic content-fetching mechanisms are present in this metadata file. As <.SRCINFO> is not an executable script but a declarative packaging metadata file, it cannot itself contain malicious logic.
